title: Simple Bouguer gravity map of part of the Carolina slate belt including the Haile and Brewer mine areas, north-central South Carolina
citation: Popenoe, Peter, and Bell, Henry, 1975, Simple Bouguer gravity map of part of the Carolina slate belt including the Haile and Brewer mine areas, north-central South Carolina: U.S. Geological Survey Geophysical Investigations Map GP-904, map scale 1:125,000.
notes: USGS GP-904 (Popenoe and Bell, 1975), simple Bouguer gravity map of part of the Carolina slate belt including the Haile and Brewer mine areas, 1:125,000 (contour interval 1 milligal, density 2.67 g/cc; gravity data 1970-73). The sheet shows only gravity contours and stations on a topographic base, with no geologic units, structures, drill holes or geologic surfaces; gravity values are geophysical and do not fit the schema, so nothing is recorded (same treatment as other single-sheet Bouguer maps). SUBSURFACE: none.
